scope.unit_definition: One target route is one on-state or off-state JPG request; one talent group is its paired on/off route set.
scope.screening_limit: Data-title and first-rank-effect screening identifies candidates; lexical similarity is only a ranking aid. Source-image pixels are not equated with 2008 pixels.

route_derivation.description: Legacy renderer takes nltalent[i][0], lowercases it, strips colon and spaces, and builds the class/tree image path. Canonical talent title and image label are therefore recorded separately.
